Publication of the review **“Iron Dysregulation in Human Cancer: Altered Metabolism, Biomarkers for Diagnosis, Prognosis, Monitoring and Rationale for Therapy”** in *Cancers*.

The article examines the role of iron metabolism in tumour biology and its potential clinical implications.

DOI: [10.3390/cancers12123524](https://doi.org/10.3390/cancers12123524).
